.github/workflows/example.yml:1:7  note  workflow-name-duplicate
  workflow name "Choosy" is also used by .github/workflows/choosy.yml; the Actions tab cannot tell them apart

context:
  triggers       push

suppress:
  add on line 1:    # jobsworth-ignore workflow-name-duplicate
  or in .jobsworth.yml:   rules: { workflow-name-duplicate: off }
